For a classic cheesecake, the best substitute for cream cheese is mascarpone cheese. It has a similar high fat content and creamy texture, which helps maintain the rich mouthfeel and structure of the dessert. To get closer to the tangy flavor of cream cheese, you can mix the mascarpone with a small amount of lemon juice or plain yogurt. Another option is blended cottage cheese or ricotta cheese, but these will result in a lighter, less dense texture and may require straining to remove excess moisture.
